artboards.title: Direction A — the dot and its window
Candidate explorer — reads the live daemon

annotations.text:
decentralized.cloud — a public face over the Hypervisor daemon.

Direction A is the leading candidate and is what the identity sheet, the system and both product surfaces are built on. B and C are live alternatives, each with its own case and its own tradeoff.

Every colour on these sheets is a token in packages/design-system. Two tokens were added to that file for this product — green-on-dark and red-700 — each for a contrast reason stated on the system sheet.

The two surfaces are deliberately different kinds of thing.

The explorer reads the running daemon. Every number on it was returned by that daemon today: 24 live quotes, all from Vast, cheapest $0.0136/hr, valid for fifteen minutes.

The composer is drawn to the canonical CloudJobRequest shape and submits nothing. It is labelled unwired on the surface itself, not only in a note.
